sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: When the thing is already clear, Hungarian can use a word of its own instead of the ending: *A kulcs az enyém.* The six words are *az enyém*, *a tiéd*, *az övé*, *a miénk*, *a tiétek* and *az övék*. To ask "whose?", say *kié*. To say what you have, use *van* and a noun with the ending; to say you do not, use *nincs*. *Saját* (own) stays the same, and the noun after it carries the ending.
Use one or the other, not both: *a kulcsom* (my key) or *a kulcs az enyém* (the key is mine). After *nincs* the word *egy* drops out: *Nincs autónk*.
